changeSet.author: nexus-lgdel.l1
changeSet.comment: Delete every nexus.frecency row whose chunk_id is not the canonical 64-hex chash shape — the legacy-width population nexus.chash_alias used to keep resolvable. Confirm-zero-or- delete-anyway (nexus-lgdel.l1): the deleted count is RAISE NOTICE'd, never gated on. RLS toggle-wrapped (nexus-1wjmq shape, catalog-029-1 precedent): frecency carries FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and Liquibase's nexus_admin owner is not BYPASSRLS, so an untoggled DELETE would silently match zero rows for every tenant.

changeSet.author: nexus-lgdel.l1
changeSet.comment: Delete every nexus.relevance_log row whose chunk_id is not the canonical 64-hex chash shape. Same RAISE NOTICE / RLS-toggle discipline as legacy-001-1 (relevance_log carries FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, telemetry-001-baseline.xml:84).

changeSet.author: nexus-lgdel.l1
changeSet.comment: ADD CHECK chunk_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' on nexus.frecency and nexus.relevance_log — the prevention that lands WITH the deletion (never after it): makes the population legacy-001-1/2 just deleted structurally impossible to regrow via direct SQL. Safe to validate immediately (not NOT VALID + separate VALIDATE): legacy-001-1/2 already committed as separate, earlier changesets in this SAME migration walk, so every existing row is already conformant by the time this ALTER evaluates it.

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE nexus.frecency DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS frecency_chunk_id_canonical_check; ALTER TABLE nexus.relevance_log DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS relevance_log_chunk_id_canonical_check;

changeSet.author: nexus-lgdel.l1
changeSet.comment: nexus.remap_membership: the `LEFT JOIN nexus.chash_alias` alias-chaining/supersession arm (remap-003-2, RDR-194 P2) is deleted, not narrowed — the map it joined is dropped two changesets from now. Layered CREATE OR REPLACE on remap-003-2's applied body (D0.2 — never editing the applied changeset in place). Signature and return contract (RETURNS TABLE (mapped_total bigint, present_count bigint), SECURITY INVOKER, STABLE) unchanged.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.remap_membership( p_source_collection text, p_target_collection text ) RETURNS TABLE(mapped_total bigint, present_count bigint) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $fn$ SELECT count(*)::bigint AS mapped_total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunks c WHERE c.collection = p_target_collection AND c.chash = r.new_chash) )::bigint AS present_count FROM nexus.chash_remap r WHERE r.source_collection = p_source_collection AND r.target_collection = p_target_collection $fn$;

rollback.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.remap_membership( p_source_collection text, p_target_collection text ) RETURNS TABLE(mapped_total bigint, present_count bigint) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $fn$ WITH resolved AS ( SELECT COALESCE(a.new_chash, r.new_chash) AS chash FROM nexus.chash_remap r LEFT JOIN nexus.chash_alias a ON a.old_bytes = r.new_chash WHERE r.source_collection = p_source_collection AND r.target_collection = p_target_collection ) SELECT count(*)::bigint AS mapped_total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunks c WHERE c.collection = p_target_collection AND c.chash = resolved.chash) )::bigint AS present_count FROM resolved $fn$;

changeSet.author: nexus-lgdel.l1
changeSet.comment: DROP TABLE nexus.chash_alias — the PERMANENT legacy-reference resolver (RDR-180 Item6, rdr180-12-chash-alias) whose beneficiary population reached zero (RDR-194 cc2, T2 rdr194-cloud-count-2-2026-08-15 [22670]). DROP TABLE cascades its two indexes (idx_chash_alias_old_bytes, idx_chash_alias_new) and its tenant_isolation RLS policy — nothing survives it that needs a separate DROP INDEX/DROP POLICY.

changeSet.author: nexus-lgdel.l1
changeSet.comment: DROP FUNCTION nexus.chash_old_bytes(text) — the string-to-bytes lemma every chash_alias.old_bytes writer used (rdr180-20). Its only production caller, ChashSqlIdioms.chashOldBytesField, is deleted in this same commit family. Precedent shape: nexus.manifest_orphans, already fully dropped (catalog-030).

rollback.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.chash_old_bytes(ref text) RETURNS bytea LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $fn$ SELECT CASE WHEN ref ~ '^[0-9a-f]+$' AND length(ref) % 2 = 0 THEN decode(ref, 'hex') ELSE convert_to(ref, 'UTF8') END $fn$;
